glossier-yellow.$description: Glossier Yellow — Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, nav links, body copy, footer text, icon strokes, hairline borders; the dominant typographic and structural color

paper.$description: Paper — Product card surfaces, input fills, elevated panels; the brightest surface level in the stack

fog.$description: Fog — Page canvas, section backgrounds, image-to-page transitions; the base surface the entire site sits on

blush.$description: Blush — Footer background, soft warm section breaks; a barely-perceptible pink-tinted off-white that adds warmth to the bottom of pages

mist.$description: Mist — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ash.$description: Ash — Input borders, badge backgrounds, hairline dividers; the structural border color for cards and form elements

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, helper copy, muted labels, form placeholder text; the only mid-gray for typographic hierarchy

slate.$description: Slate — Product list and card swatch fills; the darkest functional gray for catalog imagery placeholders

cobalt-tag.$description: Cobalt Tag — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

apercu.$description: Primary typeface across all UI — body at 16px/400, navigation and labels at 12–14px/500, subheadings at 20px/500, editorial headlines at 32px/700. Apercu's geometric humanist construction gives the brand its compressed, contemporary voice; the near-zero letter-spacing (0.002–0.003em) keeps type tight and magazine-like rather than airy or friendly. Weight 700 is reserved for editorial display moments, not UI chrome.

apercu-mono.$description: Micro-utility typography for order metadata, tracking numbers, and code-adjacent labels; the monospaced cousin creates technical texture against the proportional body face

gtstandard-m.$description: GTStandard-M — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
